test_llm_generate_text: test the llm.generate_text function to generate text responses from a prompt with configurable parameters
test_llm_generate_object: test the llm.generate_object function to generate structured Pydantic model outputs from prompts
test_llm_chat: test the llm.chat function to run multi-turn conversations with system, user, and model messages
test_google_genai_api_backend: test the GoogleGenAIAPI backend to run text generation, image generation, embedding, and tokenization via Gemini API
test_multimodal_generation: test multimodal content generation by passing image bytes alongside text prompts to the Gemini backend
